name: masar-project-root
description: Masar / San3 - Construction & Infrastructure Management Platform Monorepo

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix site install --include=dev
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python manage.py runserver
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build:site: cd site && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:site
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:site

author: San3 Engineering
